OverviewFeaturesUse casesPricingTradeoffsCompatibilityFAQ

What is Genspark?

Agentic search product that generates custom 'Sparkpages' - purpose-built summary pages assembled for your query - and runs multi-step agents including an AI phone caller, slide generator and deep research agent.

Best for

Research questions where you want an assembled page plus an agent that can act on the result.

Main features

  • Sparkpages (AI-generated, ad-free result pages)
  • Super Agent for multi-step autonomous tasks
  • AI Slides and AI Sheets
  • AI Designer
  • AI Phone Call agent that actually dials businesses
  • Deep Research
  • cross-check agent for factual verification.

Practical use cases

  • Product comparison research on a single generated page
  • booking or enquiring by AI phone call
  • generating decks from a research prompt
  • competitive analysis
  • travel planning.

Who is it for?

  • Researchers, small-business owners, marketers and anyone who wants a search engine that also executes tasks.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium with credit-based agent usage

Plans described in the source

Free tier with daily credits. Plus around $24.99/mo. Pro around $249.99/mo for high-volume agent use. Credits are consumed per agent action, with heavier agents (phone calls, deep research, video) costing far more than a simple search. Verify current tiers - Genspark has repriced repeatedly.

Free plan

Yes - free daily credit allowance covering basic search and light agent use.

Free trial

Paid features sampled via free credits rather than a time-boxed trial.

Usage limits to consider

Credit-metered: agent runs, phone calls and slide generation each draw different credit amounts. Free daily credits exhaust quickly on agent tasks.

Confirm current plans and pricing ↗

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • The AI phone-call agent is a genuinely differentiated capability
  • Sparkpages are far more readable than a list of blue links
  • strong all-in-one agent suite for the price of the Plus tier.

Limitations to consider

  • Credit accounting is opaque and burns fast
  • quality is inconsistent across agents
  • young company with rapidly shifting pricing
  • enterprise governance and data-residency story is thin
  • phone agent availability is region-limited.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, iOS, Android

Languages

  • Multilingual incl. Chinese, English, Japanese; Arabic and French supported

API access

Limited/emerging - check current developer docs

Integrations and exports

  • Google Drive, Notion, Slack and others via agent connectors
  • browser extension

Evaluation notes

Budget by expected agent runs, not by seats - the credit model is where cost escapes. Treat the Pro tier as an agent-volume purchase.
